call_sites.what: the ArtilleryGunnerBot's gravity arc; the only gun-bot caller
the envelope reroll on countdown expiry
the AAGunnerBot's lead point, no gravity term
refresh the target's pose before reading +FCh..+104h

reads.arc: closed form, the minus (low) root of D = R^2 - 4k(k+h), k = R^2 g / 2v^2, g = 9.81f at 00CF9058, v = round V0 +50h; D < 0 returns false with pitch pi/4; no drag, no iteration, no time of flight
reads.envelope: t = U(0,1), r = U(0,MaxAngleError) * t^Power, phi = U(0,2pi); (r sin phi, r cos phi); period U(3,8) s; interpolated old->new as the countdown falls; rows indexed Stun 0, SPNormal 1, SPVeteran 2, MPNormal 3, MPVeteran 4, Elite 5
reads.aa_bot_inputs: 00901C20 reads the target pose position +FCh..+104h (not the Height-raised visibility point) and leads with the target's velocity
reads.no_gravity: classDesc+20h NoGravity; this installation's Bullet (AAMG, planegun) and Flak classes set it
